name: osipy
summary: An OSIPI-standard Python library for perfusion MRI analysis across DCE, DSC, ASL and IVIM, with multi-vendor DICOM support and optional GPU acceleration. I am its most active contributor.

name: imoco
summary: Python implementation of the retrospective motion compensation methods compared in our 2026 JMRI paper, from soft gating and XD-GRASP to iMoCo, for free-breathing UTE lung MRI.

name: fw-classification
summary: An open-source package for classifying MRI scans, so large imaging datasets can be sorted and curated automatically.

name: OSIPI ASL library
summary: A composite Python library for arterial spin labelling image processing, built with the ISMRM Open Science Initiative for Perfusion Imaging.

name: sigpy_demons
summary: The demons image registration algorithm implemented with the SigPy toolbox, so it can run on the GPU.

name: pcviprDocker
summary: A Docker image that installs Orchestra and PC VIPR, so the reconstruction toolchain can be set up reproducibly.
